content.short: Crafting game where players combine elements to discover new recipes and win jackpots.
content.description: Mystic Forge is a discovery game: players combine elements, and whoever finds a recipe first claims a legendary artifact and a jackpot. Packs give new elements and bonuses, and its MST token trades on a built-in exchange, with mining NFTs for regular players. Crafting went live on 30 April 2026, and the game runs in World App and on Telegram.
content.meta: Combine elements to discover recipes first and win jackpots in Mystic Forge, a crafting game in World App and Telegram.
